why_passes: A review is a loop, not a pass. It repeats until a full pass over every instrument finds nothing, because a pass that finds something is evidence the one before it was not finished -- the fix is new code, and the technique that found it may find more. The hook refuses a ledger whose last pass has findings.

required.head: the commit the review covers
required.base: the commit it starts from; the ledger is named <base>.json
required.passes: [] -- one entry per pass, in order: {pass: 1, instruments: [], findings: []}

pass.instruments: [] -- one row per id in instruments.json, EVERY pass: {id, status: applied|na, evidence|why}
pass.findings: [] -- empty on the last pass, or the review is not over

finding.found_by: the instrument id that found it. If no instrument covers the technique, add one to instruments.json first -- that is the ratchet.

control.patch: repo-relative path under .review/controls/ to a patch that REVERTS this fix
control.tests: [] -- narrow selectors. Each runs TWICE: it must PASS at HEAD, then produce a real test failure with the patch applied. A patch that breaks the build is refused, because a suite that cannot run is not a test that failed.
control.observed: what was seen when it was run by hand
